note: Income effects transcribed from the wiki facility tables with their units kept intact. Keyed by the facility ids in assets/data/facilities_jsons/*.json. Facilities absent from this map have no verified income effect. Per the game FAQ, effects of every UNLOCKED facility combine, regardless of which one is displayed - the single exception is the Flowerbed.

channels.tipCap: cod - adds to the tip jar capacity. Restaurant Tip Desk only.
channels.tipPerMinute: cod per minute accumulated into the tip jar, online and offline, until the jar is full.
channels.buffetCodPerHour: cod per hour from the Buffet, accrued offline, capped at 12 hours of accrual.
channels.buffetPlatesPerDay: plates dropped once per day after the daily reset.
channels.codPerSeconds: cod produced every `seconds` seconds while the game is open (tap to collect).
channels.codPerPurchase: cod added to each customer purchase in the restaurant.
channels.codPerFlowerView: cod earned each time a terrace customer views a flower.
channels.terracePayFlat: cod added to what each terrace customer pays.
channels.terracePayPercent: percent added to what each terrace customer pays.
channels.codPerGather: cod, random in [min,max], per Courtyard gather.
channels.filmPerGather: film, random in [min,max], per Courtyard gather.
channels.petPlayCod: cod granted after playing with a pet.
channels.petPlayFilm: film granted after playing with a pet.
channels.filmPerPassedGame: film per passed Game Machine round.
channels.filmPerExcellentGame: film per excellent Game Machine round.
channels.freeRevivePercent: percent chance of a free revive in the Game Machine.
channels.takeoutOrders: extra takeout orders available per day.
channels.cookingEfficiencyPercent: stove cooking efficiency, in percent, as printed on the wiki.
channels.performerChancePercent: percent added to the chance of inviting a performer.
channels.flowerViews: extra flower views from the Garden Table.
channels.tableRefreshes: free daily refreshes of the terrace table items.
channels.waterXp: watering XP earned watering a friend’s plants.
channels.bandProfitPercent: percent added to the earnings of the named band, from Concert wall/floor decor.
